command:
mkdir -p /etc/nginx/ssl /var/log/cert-renew
cat > /usr/local/sbin/renew-cert.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
SSL_DIR=/etc/nginx/ssl
CA_KEY=$SSL_DIR/ca-key.pem
CA_CERT=$SSL_DIR/ca-cert.pem
KEY=$SSL_DIR/server-key.pem
CSR=$SSL_DIR/server.csr
CERT=$SSL_DIR/server-cert.pem
CERT_TMP=$SSL_DIR/server-cert.pem.new
KEY_TMP=$SSL_DIR/server-key.pem.new
LOG=/var/log/cert-renew/renew.log

# Ensure CA exists (created once, long-lived)
if [ ! -f "$CA_KEY" ] || [ ! -f "$CA_CERT" ]; then
    openssl genrsa -out "$CA_KEY" 2048 2>>"$LOG"
    openssl req -x509 -new -key "$CA_KEY" -sha256 -days 3650 \
        -subj "/CN=Internal-Test-CA" -out "$CA_CERT" 2>>"$LOG"
fi

# Decide whether renewal is needed: no cert yet, or expiring within RENEW_BEFORE seconds
RENEW_BEFORE=$((10*60))
NEED_RENEW=0
if [ ! -f "$CERT" ] || [ ! -f "$KEY" ]; then
    NEED_RENEW=1
else
    if ! openssl x509 -checkend "$RENEW_BEFORE" -noout -in "$CERT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        NEED_RENEW=1
    fi
fi

if [ "$NEED_RENEW" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) no renewal needed" >> "$LOG"
    exit 0
fi

echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) renewing certificate" >> "$LOG"

openssl genrsa -out "$KEY_TMP" 2048 2>>"$LOG"
openssl req -new -key "$KEY_TMP" -subj "/CN=node1.internal" -out "$CSR" 2>>"$LOG"
openssl x509 -req -in "$CSR" -CA "$CA_CERT" -CAkey "$CA_KEY" -CAcreateserial \
    -out "$CERT_TMP" -days 1 -sha256 \
    -extfile <(printf "subjectAltName=DNS:node1.internal,IP:%s" "$NODE_IP") 2>>"$LOG"

mv "$KEY_TMP" "$KEY"
mv "$CERT_TMP" "$CERT"
rm -f "$CSR"
chmod 600 "$KEY"

echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) renewed, new serial: $(openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -serial)" >> "$LOG"

# Reload nginx if it's active, so it picks up the new cert without dropping connections
if systemctl is-active --quiet nginx; then
    nginx -t 2>>"$LOG" && systemctl reload nginx && echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) nginx reloaded" >> "$LOG"
fi
EOF
chmod 700 /usr/local/sbin/renew-cert.sh
echo done
